title: Comparison of conventional corneal crosslinking with the accelerated procedure in progressive keratoconus

groups.description: Standard CXL protocol (S-CXL, 3 mW/cm2 for 30 min; Abstract '3*30', Introduction 5.4 J/cm2) for progressive keratoconus (Kmax increase >= 1 D within one year); one eye per patient; TU Dresden, enrolled 2009-2013. Age group 'mixed': mean age 23.4 +/- 8.3 years (Results) and the Complications paragraph places S-CXL patients aged 17 to 25 years.

Accelerated CXL protocol (A-CXL, 9 mW/cm2 for 10 min; Abstract '9*10', Introduction) for progressive keratoconus; one eye per patient; same centre and period. Mean age 28.1 +/- 10.9 years; age range not stated.

series.baseline_label: Baseline Kmax (D), Table 2 'Baseline' column, S-CXL row
series.notes: mean +/- SD (95% CI of the mean), Pentacam HR; n = 16 eyes at baseline (Table 1); per-visit n not reported; 2 patients lost to follow-up 3 and 8 years after CXL; 4 patients needed CXL retreatment after a mean follow-up of 61.3 +/- 23.9 months and the article does not state whether their later measurements are in the Table 2 means.

series.baseline_label: Baseline Kmax (D), Table 2 'Baseline' column, A-CXL row
series.notes: mean +/- SD (95% CI of the mean), Pentacam HR; n = 45 eyes at baseline (Table 1); per-visit n not reported; 16 patients lost to follow-up between 3 and 8 years; 2 patients excluded from subsequent follow-up after further procedures (alcohol keratectomy, DMEK); 5 patients needed repeat CXL after a mean follow-up of 46.4 +/- 29.1 months and one more was indicated for retreatment after 96 months; the article does not state whether measurements after retreatment are in the Table 2 means.

notes: Inclusion required one eye per patient and all measurements on the same Pentacam HR (device-consistency criterion stated in Methods, not an outcome-defined selection); losses to follow-up are retained as ordinary attrition.
Analysis used a linear mixed model with Bonferroni correction for p-values; the Table 2 values are the reported descriptive means +/- SD with 95% CI of the mean, not model-adjusted means.

Epithelium removal is not restated for either protocol in the article text (procedure described in reference [9] and Supplement 1, not available here); A-CXL is classified cxl_accelerated as the accelerated version (stated 9 mW/cm2) of the standard protocol, with no transepithelial technique described.
Other tabulated parameters (ISV, IVA, TCT, CCT in Table 2; densitometry in Table 3; higher-order aberrations in Table 4; best-corrected visual acuity in Table 5) are not used.

Retreatment handling: the article reports retreatments in both groups during follow-up but not whether post-retreatment visits are included or censored in Table 2 (the Discussion mentions dropouts from follow-up treatments); the series are kept with this note.
